title: Задержка поезда
description: Понимаем объявление о задержке и уточняем следующий возможный рейс.
notes: How long …? спрашивает о длительности ожидания.

exercises.prompt: Что значит The train is delayed?

options.label: It will not run at all.
It will leave later than planned.

exercises.editorial_answer: It will leave later than planned.
exercises.explanation: Delayed сообщает о более позднем отправлении, не обязательно об отмене.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.

exercises.editorial_answer: What time does the next train leave?

public_payload.sentence: When do the next bus arrive?

accepted: When does the next bus arrive?

exercises.reference_answer: When does the next bus arrive?
exercises.incorrect_answer: When do the next bus arrive?
exercises.editorial_answer: When does the next bus arrive?
exercises.explanation: The next bus — единственное число, поэтому does.

accepted: The train is twenty minutes late.
The train is delayed by twenty minutes.

exercises.reference_answer: The train is twenty minutes late.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The train is twenty minutes early.
exercises.editorial_answer: The train is twenty minutes late.

exercises.prompt: Нужно ли пассажирам задержанного поезда покупать новые билеты?

options.label: Only passengers on platform four must pay again.

public_payload.passage: The 10:15 train to York is delayed by thirty minutes because of a signal problem. It will still leave from platform four. Passengers for Leeds should use platform two for the 10:25 train. The announcement says that tickets for the delayed York service remain valid, so passengers do not need to buy new ones.

exercises.explanation: Remain valid означает, что прежние билеты продолжают действовать.

exercises.prompt: Объясни, что он задержан, но не отменён.

options.label: No, it's delayed. It should leave in twenty minutes.
No, your seat is by the window.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, it's delayed. It should leave in twenty minutes.

exercises.prompt: Выбери слово для места посадки на поезд.

options.label: gate number for boarding a plane

exercises.explanation: Для железной дороги используется platform; остальные варианты не обозначают платформу.
